comment: Declarative media-tool distribution data. The install UNIT is the complete capability: ffmpeg (with the configured encoder/filters) AND ffprobe together. A strategy that cannot provide both is never advertised as ready. 'downloads' is intentionally empty: no curated complete (ffmpeg+ffprobe) pinned archive has been hash-verified by this repository's contract tests yet, and hashes/URLs are never invented. Users on platforms without a package-manager strategy can supply an offline bundle descriptor (gd/workbench 'user-bundle' option).

strategies.label: 用 Windows 包管理器安装 FFmpeg
strategies.detail: winget install --id Gyan.FFmpeg -e（完整套件，含 ffmpeg 与 ffprobe、libx264 与 libass；签名与哈希由 winget 校验，安装在当前用户目录）
strategies.license: FFmpeg 以 GPL 分发；libx264 为 GPL，libass 为 ISC。由你的系统从你确认的源安装，GameDirector 不分发这些二进制。

strategies.label: 用 Homebrew 安装 FFmpeg
strategies.detail: brew install ffmpeg（完整套件，同时提供 ffmpeg 与 ffprobe，含 libx264 与 libass）
strategies.license: FFmpeg 以 GPL 分发；由你的系统从 Homebrew 源安装。

userBundle.label: 安装用户提供的离线 FFmpeg 套件
userBundle.detail: 从本地核验描述文件（bundle descriptor JSON）安装完整的 ffmpeg+ffprobe：每个文件的 SHA-256 全部核验通过后才会装入当前用户的 GameDirector 媒体目录；描述文件不完整或核验失败则拒绝。
userBundle.license: 由你在描述文件中声明来源与许可证；GameDirector 只核验哈希，不替你确认许可证。

descriptorSchema.rid: optional; if present must equal the current runtime identifier
descriptorSchema.archive: optional path (.zip/.tar.gz/.tgz) relative to the descriptor folder
descriptorSchema.archiveSha256: required when archive is present; lowercase hex

ffmpeg.path: path inside the archive, or relative to the descriptor folder

descriptorSchema.license: free text, surfaced in the receipt
descriptorSchema.source: free text, surfaced in the receipt
